component.name: Noire
component.summary: Native microphone noise suppression for PipeWire

description.p: Noire publishes a noise-reduced virtual microphone for browsers, voice clients, recorders, and other PipeWire applications.
The desktop interface controls a per-user background service. Audio remains on the local machine and Noire does not modify global PipeWire or WirePlumber configuration.
Fixes startup tray feedback and controller state synchronization.

ul.li: Waits for the desktop tray host before reporting a persistent tray problem.
Keeps the controller and tray icon aligned with the authoritative daemon state after relaunch.

description.p: Polishes controller layout, portable desktop behavior, and live meters.

ul.li: Balances the home and settings side margins against the existing top spacing.
Supplies the embedded Noire icon to Wayland and X11 taskbars, including unintegrated AppImages.
Removes the mapped tray keepalive window while preserving zero-window tray operation.
Shows physical-input telemetry while bypassed and processed-output telemetry while noise reduction is active.

description.p: Fixes tray-only window lifetime and settings page spacing.

ul.li: Keeps tray-only event-loop support unmapped so closing to tray leaves no desktop window.
Ensures opening and closing the controller cannot create duplicate windows.
Matches settings margins and header padding to the home screen.

description.p: Fixes tray-only startup and login behavior on Linux desktops.

ul.li: Prevents the hidden event-loop controller from appearing as a duplicate ghost window.
Keeps tray registration alive when the desktop tray host starts after Noire.
Refreshes managed login startup entries after AppImage paths move during upgrades.

description.p: Polishes tray recovery and desktop error feedback.

ul.li: Restores the saved close-to-tray behavior after a desktop tray host returns.
Waits through brief shell restarts before showing the fallback window, avoiding focus and window churn.
Keeps dismissed recurring errors quiet until the underlying error resolves or changes.
Aligns degraded processing visuals with recovery status and keeps the presentation contract tied to visible UI.

description.p: Hardens recovery feedback and desktop tray behavior.

ul.li: Preserves observed input devices while recovering from inactive native audio sessions.
Reports configuration rollback failures consistently in the desktop interface and command-line client.
Adds dismissible recurring-error notices and renders the service's actual recovery status.
Restores the visible window when the tray host disappears and standardizes desktop activation across packaged formats.

description.p: Improves long-running audio recovery and desktop responsiveness.

ul.li: Recovers automatically when a transient model or transport failure would otherwise leave the virtual microphone silent.
Removes blocking registry scans from the idle monitor and cancels stale queued commands after timeouts.
Makes source-buffer cleanup callback-safe and reports rollback or live-processing failures instead of hiding degraded state.
Keeps tray window sessions in one application lifetime and clarifies custom strength, recurring error, and recovery feedback.

description.p: Fixes desktop startup and background resource lifecycle.

ul.li: Prevents the window startup crash and validates real GPUI and finished AppImage launches before release.
Keeps host graphics-driver discovery available when the desktop does not define XDG data paths.
Reopens the existing window from repeated launcher clicks without creating duplicate controllers or tray items.
Stops tray-only sessions from capturing microphone meters and reliably releases metering after clients disconnect.

description.p: Makes tray control and startup behavior reliable.

ul.li: Keeps the window, tray icon, and tray actions synchronized with acknowledged daemon state.
Starts noise reduction off by default and adds a separate opt-in for enabling it on startup.
Stops processing on Quit and retires stale AppImage or Flatpak background services safely.

description.p: Fixes AppImage integration and desktop layout.

ul.li: Removes the obsolete launcher left by Noire 1.1.0 when the same AppImage is integrated by an application manager.
Places Start and Stop beside the processing status instead of in a separate centered row.
Balances the signal-path waveform icon with the microphone and shield icons.

description.p: Fixes portable startup and desktop behavior.

ul.li: Repairs AppImage PipeWire startup and prevents portable launches from writing desktop files.
Follows the system appearance by default, adds a true light theme, and repositions Start and Stop.
Improves microphone names and guards against conflicting control requests.

description.p: Replaces the GTK interface with a native GPUI controller and ships FastEnhancer-B noise reduction.

ul.li: Adds dark and gray light themes, microphone metering, tray controls, and persistent desktop preferences.
Publishes the virtual input as Noire Microphone ☾ and improves physical-device selection.
Adds DEB, RPM, Flatpak, and AppImage packages.

description.p: Qualification disclosure: the eight-hour soak recorded two isolated sampled model calls above the 0.75 ms target without entering degraded mode. The owner waived the planned 15-hour soak and the remaining human, application, clean-VM, idle-resource, and signed-package qualification for this release.
